experiment: E2: fixed-budget IM (Gurobi) versus BPC upper-bound comparison
purpose: Compare the best feasible integer objective obtained under equal time budgets.
process_assumption: All items in a batch leave the autoclave and enter inventory together at the batch maximum curing duration.

metric_definition.gurobi_ub: Best feasible integer objective from compact IM.
metric_definition.gurobi_lb: Gurobi's best bound (ObjBound), including time-limit runs when available.
metric_definition.gurobi_nodes: Gurobi MIP node count reported by the compact IM solve.
metric_definition.bpc_ub: Best feasible integer objective from BPC.
metric_definition.bpc_lb: BPC's global lower bound from the branch-and-price tree when available.
metric_definition.bpc_lb_certified: True only when every processed BPC node has a valid certified lower bound.
metric_definition.bpc_nodes_explored: Number of BPC nodes processed, including the root node.
metric_definition.bpc_nodes_created: Total BPC nodes created, including the root node.
metric_definition.bpc_nodes_pruned: BPC nodes pruned by bound, infeasibility, or incumbent dominance.
metric_definition.solver_gap_pct: Each solver's own certified optimality gap; this is distinct from the UB improvement metric.
